scenes.setting: Mr. A's blackboard spells The Fool's three lines in plain Loen with a warning never to read them in Hermes; the room debates whether it's a cult while Fors panics inwardly — and both she and Xio trace the paper with that honorific name back to a book borrowed from a cheerfully oblivious Viscount Glaint
scenes.text_anchor: “Why are you looking at me like that?”

scenes.setting: The candlelit 'academic' meeting: furniture merchant Stephen Hampres reads Audrey aloud and dubs her 'Miss Angel' — while she reads him right back down to his vanity, finances and cologne — then listens through talk of the Body of Heart and Mind and the collective subconscious

Jolted awake above the gray fog by Miss Magician's report: the Aurora Order has his honorific name. The leak traces to Little Sun's ritual and the All-Black Eye's corruption — so the Eye never leaves the fog again — and Mr. A's public bounty is either idiocy or fishing
scenes.text_anchor: The Aurora Order knows of The Fool? They know of my honorific name?
